welcome.setupNotice: This is the empty starter application. Features arrive module by module in Phase 1.

settings.intro: Settings for your organisation. You see the sections your role allows.
settings.noAccess: Your role does not include any settings. Contact your administrator if you need access.
settings.unavailable: Settings cannot be shown right now. Please try again shortly.

users.title: Users
users.description: People of your organisation: roles, languages, skills and availability.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What each role may do: permissions, field rules and second factor.

groups.title: Groups

categories.title: Categories

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Sites, buildings and floors, up to three levels.

skills.title: Skills

slaPolicies.description: Response and resolution targets per priority, escalations, and which tickets they apply to.

businessCalendars.title: Business calendars
businessCalendars.description: Working hours, weekends and public holidays that SLA clocks count.

customerGroups.title: Customer groups
customerGroups.description: Groups of requesters with their own SLA policies, by email domain or by name.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Which events notify people, their wording in English and Arabic, test emails and the email delivery log.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Forms with fields, rules and field sets, and which category uses which form.

fieldSets.description: Groups of fields shared by many forms.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Departments people belong to, used by forms and services.

cannedResponses.title: Canned responses
cannedResponses.description: Reply wording in English and Arabic for you, your groups or everyone.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Services and their cards, the catalogs that group them, reviews and templates.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.description: Mailboxes that turn emails into incidents, who may write in, and the mailbox log.

liveChat.title: Live chat
liveChat.description: Chat widgets for the portal and your websites, and the group that answers.

customerVoice.title: Customer voice
customerVoice.description: Anonymous messages, complaint severities and root causes, and the happiness meter.

language.intro: These defaults apply to everyone who has not chosen their own in their profile, and to visitors who are not signed in. Visitors whose browser asks for English or Arabic see that language.
language.failed: The defaults could not be saved. Please try again.
language.neverChanged: Not changed yet: the platform defaults apply.

translations.intro: Each of these needs a value in both languages before go-live. Until then, screens show the language that is available.
translations.none: Every text has both an English and an Arabic version.

search.intro: Search lets people find records in English and Arabic. Changes are added to the search index a few seconds after they are saved.
search.needsAttention: Needs attention: some updates could not be indexed
search.unavailable: The search engine is not reachable
search.failed: Updates that could not be indexed
search.rebuildHelp: Sends every searchable record to the index again and removes entries whose records no longer exist. Search keeps working while it runs. Use it if results look out of date.
search.rebuildConfirmText: Rebuild the search index now? This is recorded in the audit log.
search.rebuildQueued: Rebuild started: {count, plural, one {{formatted} record was} other {{formatted} records were}} sent to the index.
search.rebuildFailed: The rebuild could not be started. Please try again.
search.refreshFailed: The status could not be refreshed. Please try again.

uaePass.title: UAE PASS
uaePass.intro: People can sign in with UAE PASS, the UAE national digital identity. Enter the client ID and client secret issued to your organisation by the UAE PASS programme.
uaePass.enabled: Offer UAE PASS on the sign-in page

environments.Staging: Staging (for testing with UAE PASS staging accounts)

uaePass.clientSecretSet: A client secret is saved (last changed {date}). Leave this empty to keep it.
uaePass.clientSecretMissing: No client secret is saved yet.
uaePass.acceptAsSecondFactor: Accept UAE PASS as the second factor for staff
uaePass.acceptAsSecondFactorHint: Only verified UAE PASS accounts (SOP2 or higher) count. When this is off, staff confirm their sign-in with their authenticator app after UAE PASS.
uaePass.staffMinimum: Staff always need a verified UAE PASS account ({level} or higher). This cannot be changed.
uaePass.requesterMinimumLevel: Minimum UAE PASS account level for requesters
uaePass.createRequesters: Create requester accounts automatically on first UAE PASS sign-in
uaePass.createRequestersHint: When this is off, only people who already have an account can sign in with UAE PASS. Staff accounts are never created automatically: they are matched by the Emirates ID recorded on their account, or by email once the account's owner confirms it.
uaePass.redirectUriHint: Register this address with the UAE PASS programme as your redirect URI.
uaePass.saved: The UAE PASS settings are saved.
uaePass.failed: The UAE PASS settings could not be saved. Please try again.

errors.clientId: Enter the client ID issued by UAE PASS (no spaces).
errors.clientSecret: Enter the client secret issued by UAE PASS.
errors.environment: Choose one of the environments in the list.
errors.unavailable: The sign-in service did not accept the change, so nothing was changed. Please try again shortly.

signIn.intro: Choose how people sign in to your organisation's Zelvo.
signIn.uaePassDescription: Sign-in with the UAE national digital identity: environment, client credentials and rules for staff and requesters.

incidents.intro: These settings apply to every incident in your organisation. A changed matrix gives new priorities to incidents as they change.
incidents.matrixIntro: Name the levels of impact and urgency (level 1 is the highest) and the five priorities, then choose the priority of each combination.
incidents.matrixTable: Priority of each combination of impact and urgency
incidents.reasonsIntro: Agents choose one of the active reasons when they put an incident on hold. Reasons in use can be made inactive but not removed.
incidents.prefixHint: Capital letters or digits, for example INC gives INC-000123. Numbers are never reused.
incidents.autoCloseHint: Requesters can reopen a resolved incident until it closes.
incidents.failed: The settings could not be saved. Check the values and try again.
incidents.inUse: Incidents on hold use a reason you removed. Make it inactive instead.
incidents.autoCloseBusinessDays: Count working days of the default business calendar

attachments.intro: Files people attach to incidents. Every file's content must match its type.
attachments.scanningOn: Every file is checked for malware before anyone can open it. Files with malware are rejected and recorded in the audit log.
attachments.scanningOff: Malware scanning is turned off for this installation. Files can be opened without being checked.
attachments.failed: The settings could not be saved. Choose at least one file type and a size from 1 to 100 MB.

integrations.intro: Connect other systems to Zelvo. Each integration has its own role, permissions and rate limit, and every call is logged.
integrations.environmentHelp: Integrations receive this in every API response and webhook, so they can tell test data from live data.
integrations.failed: This could not be done. Please try again.

permissions.audit_read: Read and verify the audit log
permissions.directory_manage: Change categories, locations, skills, groups and assignment rules
permissions.directory_read: See groups, skills and assignment rules
permissions.ai_manage: Manage AI providers, features, the MCP server and MCP servers
permissions.knowledge_publish: Review, publish and retire knowledge articles
permissions.notifications_manage: Change notifications and see the email delivery log
permissions.forms_manage: Change forms, field sets and which form each category uses
permissions.catalog_manage: Build the service catalog and import service cards
permissions.requests_edit: Change the state of service requests
permissions.channels_manage: Set up mailboxes and live chat widgets
permissions.chat_handle: Answer live chats of their groups
permissions.voice_read: See every complaint, inquiry and suggestion
permissions.voice_edit: Work on complaints, inquiries and suggestions
permissions.voice_report: See the customer voice and happiness report
permissions.voice_manage: Change customer voice settings and the happiness meter

events.user_updated: A user's name, email, status, Emirates ID or roles changed
events.role_updated: A role's name, permissions or field rules changed
events.ticket_sla_threshold: A ticket reached an SLA escalation threshold
events.ticket_sla_breached: A ticket passed an SLA target

clients.intro: API keys are sent in the {header} header. OAuth clients get access tokens at the token URL with the client credentials grant.
clients.name: Name

kindHelp.ApiKey: A single key that the other system sends with each call.
kindHelp.OAuthClient: A client ID and secret that the other system exchanges for short-lived access tokens.

clients.scopesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
clients.scopesHelp: The integration can use only the permissions you tick, and only while its role has them. Managing users, roles, sign-in and integrations is never available to integrations.
clients.noScopes: This role has no permissions that can be given to integrations.
clients.rateLimitHelp: From 1 to {max}. Calls above the limit are refused until the next minute.
clients.rotateConfirmText: Replace the key or secret of {name}? The current one stops working at once.
clients.revokeConfirmText: Revoke {name}? Its calls are refused from now on. This cannot be undone.

secret.title: Copy it now
secret.warning: This is the only time it is shown. Store it somewhere safe; Zelvo keeps only a fingerprint and cannot show it again.

webhooks.intro: Zelvo posts the events you choose to your URL, signed with a secret (Standard Webhooks format). Failed deliveries are retried for about a day.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.urlHelp: An https:// address. Addresses on internal networks work only if the installation allows them.

urlProblems.address-not-allowed: Webhooks cannot be sent to this address: it is this server or an internal or reserved network.
urlProblems.url-invalid: Use a full https:// address without a user name, password or #fragment.

webhook.testOk: The receiver accepted the test event: status {status} in {ms} ms.
webhook.testFailed: The receiver did not accept the test event.
webhook.pausedText: Paused: no events are sent until you resume it.
webhook.disabledText: Zelvo switched this webhook off after repeated failed deliveries. Check the receiver, then turn it on again.
webhook.rotateText: For 24 hours each webhook is signed with both the new and the previous secret, so the receiver can switch without missing events.
webhook.rotating: Signed with the new and previous secrets until {date}.
webhook.deleteConfirmText: Delete {name} and its delivery log? This cannot be undone.
webhook.verifyHelp: Receivers check the webhook-signature header with the signing secret, as described at standardwebhooks.com.
webhook.redelivered: Queued to be sent again within seconds.

errorKinds.http: The receiver answered with an error status.
errorKinds.timeout: The receiver did not answer in time.
errorKinds.connection-failed: Zelvo could not connect to the receiver.
errorKinds.address-not-allowed: The address is on a network webhooks may not reach.
errorKinds.redirect: The receiver answered with a redirect; redirects are not followed.
errorKinds.subscription-not-active: The webhook was paused or switched off.
errorKinds.too-many-failures: Too many deliveries in a row failed.

log.intro: Every API call made by an integration and every webhook Zelvo sent, kept for {days} days. Personal data in payloads is masked.

importExport.intro: Move users in and out of Zelvo with CSV or Excel files. Files use the column names below; Arabic text is kept.
importExport.exportHelp: Only the fields your role may see are included. Exports are recorded in the audit log.

columns.email: Email address; matches each row to an existing user. Required.
columns.emiratesId: Emirates ID number (15 digits starting with 784), to match UAE PASS sign-ins.
columns.roles: Role keys separated by semicolons, for example agent;approver. Replaces the user's roles.

importExport.importHelp: Empty cells leave a value as it is. New people start as active requesters unless the file gives roles, and sign in with an email code, UAE PASS or by choosing a password. Every row is checked first: if any row has a problem, nothing is changed.
importExport.file: CSV or Excel file (up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows)
importExport.checked: Check finished: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} read. Nothing has been changed yet.
importExport.applied: Import finished: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} read.
importExport.notApplied: Nothing was changed because of the problems below.

errorCodes.email-required: Every row needs an email address.
errorCodes.email-duplicate: This email address is in the file more than once.
errorCodes.email-ambiguous: More than one user has this email address; change them one by one.
errorCodes.emirates-id-invalid: Use the 15-digit Emirates ID number, starting with 784.
errorCodes.emirates-id-in-use: Another user has this Emirates ID.
errorCodes.emirates-id-duplicate: Another row has the same Emirates ID.
errorCodes.cannot-disable-self: You cannot disable your own account.
errorCodes.last-tenant-admin: The organisation needs at least one active administrator.
errorCodes.field-read-only: Your role may not change this column.

importExport.failed: The file could not be imported. Please try again.
importExport.badFile: The file could not be read. Use a .csv or .xlsx file with the column names in the first row.
importExport.noImport: Your role may export users but not import them.

ai.intro: Zelvo ships no AI model of its own: AI features stay off until you connect your own provider and turn features on. Personal data is masked before anything is sent, and every AI call is logged.
ai.failed: That did not work. Try again, and if it keeps failing, contact your system administrator.
ai.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

errors.provider-auth-failed: The provider refused the API key. Check the key and the account.
errors.provider-rate-limited: The provider is limiting requests, or the account has no credit left.
errors.provider-unavailable: The provider is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.provider-rejected: The provider refused the request. Check the model name and the endpoint.
errors.provider-invalid-response: The provider's answer could not be read. Check the endpoint.
errors.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
errors.address-not-allowed: Zelvo may not connect to this address.
errors.connection-failed: Zelvo could not connect to the provider.
errors.key-unreadable: The stored API key cannot be read. Enter it again.
errors.invalid-json: The answer was not in the form the feature needs.
errors.limit-reached: The monthly AI spending limit is reached.

providers.intro: Connect one or more AI providers with your own API key. Keys are stored encrypted and are never shown again. Each feature uses the provider and model you choose for it.
providers.empty: No AI provider is connected, so AI is off.

kindHelp.Anthropic: Claude models from Anthropic, with an API key from the Anthropic Console.
kindHelp.OpenAI: GPT models from OpenAI, with an API key from the OpenAI platform.
kindHelp.AzureOpenAI: OpenAI models on your organisation's Azure resource (the service behind Microsoft Copilot).
kindHelp.Gemini: Gemini models from Google, with an API key from Google AI Studio.
kindHelp.OpenAICompatible: Any server that offers the OpenAI Chat Completions API, including a model you host on your own servers for offline networks.

endpointHelp.Anthropic: Leave empty to use Anthropic's public address.
endpointHelp.OpenAI: Leave empty to use OpenAI's public address.
endpointHelp.AzureOpenAI: Your resource address, for example https://my-resource.openai.azure.com.
endpointHelp.Gemini: Leave empty to use Google's public address.
endpointHelp.OpenAICompatible: The API address, for example https://llm.example.ae/v1. Addresses on your internal network must be allowed by the installation's operator.

providers.apiVersionHelp: Only for resources that still use deployment addresses, for example 2024-10-21. Leave empty for Azure's v1 API.
providers.apiKeyHelp: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again.
providers.newKeyHelp: Leave empty to keep the stored key. If you change the endpoint, enter the key again.
providers.modelHelp: The model id as the provider names it (for Azure OpenAI, the deployment name).
providers.noModelsListed: This provider does not list its models. Type the model name.
providers.modelsListed: {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}} found. Pick one in the model field.
providers.name: Name
providers.keyAgain: Enter the API key again when you change the endpoint.
providers.keyInvalid: Enter the API key exactly as the provider gave it.

endpointProblems.address-not-allowed: Zelvo may not connect to this address (this server, internal or reserved networks). The installation's operator can allow internal networks for self-hosted models.
endpointProblems.url-invalid: Use a full address without query string, user name, password or #fragment.

features.intro: Choose a provider and model for each feature, for example a fast model for triage and a stronger one for summaries. A feature makes no AI calls while it is off.

descriptions.triage: Suggests the category, priority and team for new tickets; agents accept or correct the suggestion.
descriptions.reply: Drafts replies from the knowledge base in the agent's chosen language.
descriptions.translation: Translates messages with one click, so agent and requester can each use their own language.
descriptions.duplicates: Finds tickets that report the same issue.
descriptions.sentiment: Detects frustrated customers so they can be escalated.
descriptions.virtualAgent: Answers questions in the portal and chat from the knowledge base and hands over to a person.
descriptions.articleDrafts: Drafts knowledge articles from resolved tickets for review.

features.needsProviderAndModel: Choose a provider and a model before turning the feature on.
features.providerOff: This provider is switched off. Switch it on, or choose another provider.
features.modelInvalid: Enter the model id as the provider names it, without spaces.

prices.intro: Enter what each model costs, so that the usage dashboard can show cost and the monthly limit can be applied. Calls of a model without a price are counted, but have no cost.
prices.help: Use the prices on your provider's price list or contract. A new price applies to calls from now on.
prices.invalid: Enter US dollars per million tokens from 0 to 10,000.

usage.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# call has} other {# calls have}} no cost because the model has no price. Enter prices under Prices.
usage.noLimit: No limit is set. Spent this month: {spent}.
usage.warning: {percent} % or more of this month's limit is spent.
usage.reached: The limit is reached: AI features are stopped until {date} or until you raise the limit.
usage.limitHelp: 0 or empty means no limit. You see a warning at {percent} %, and AI calls stop at 100 % until the next calendar month (UTC). Only calls of models with a price count.
usage.limitInvalid: Enter US dollars from 0 to 1,000,000, with up to 2 decimals.
usage.dailyLabel: Bar chart of cost per day; the highest day cost {max}. Use “Show as table” for the figures.

log.intro: Every AI call: who it was for, which feature, provider and model, the outcome, tokens and cost. What was sent and the answer are kept with personal data masked for 30 days.
log.masked: {count, plural, one {# personal value masked} other {# personal values masked}}
log.expired: The text is no longer kept (30 days).

mcp.intro: Zelvo's built-in MCP server lets AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio or your own agents work with Zelvo. Each agent connects with its own API key or OAuth client from Settings → Integrations and gets only the tools you turn on that its role allows.
mcp.connectHelp: Give the agent the address of the Zelvo API followed by this path, your organisation in the X-Zelvo-Tenant header, and its own credential. It uses the Streamable HTTP transport.
mcp.approvalHelp: Changes need the approval of a person who may make the change themselves, unless you turn approval off for an agent and tool. Requests expire after {hours} hours. Every action is in the audit log, marked as done by an AI agent.
mcp.noAgents: No integration is an AI agent yet.
mcp.noCandidates: To add an AI agent, first create an API key or OAuth client in Settings → Integrations.
mcp.addAgent: Make an integration an AI agent
mcp.notAllowed: Its role and scopes do not allow this (needs {permission}).
mcp.noActivity: No AI agent has asked for a change yet.
mcp.invalid: Check the tools: some are not allowed for this integration.

tools.get_incident: Read an incident and its status

mcpServers.intro: Zelvo's AI can use tools of your own MCP servers, for example an HR or asset system. Tools start off; turn on the ones the AI may use. Tools that change data run only after a person approves each use. Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again.
mcpServers.empty: No MCP server is set up.
mcpServers.name: Name
mcpServers.urlHelp: The server's Streamable HTTP address, for example https://hr.example.ae/mcp.
mcpServers.authHeaderHelp: Authorization sends "Bearer" and the credential; other headers send the credential as it is.
mcpServers.secretHelp: Leave empty if the server needs none.
mcpServers.invalid: Check the details and try again.
mcpServers.noTools: No tools yet: test the connection to read them.
mcpServers.changesDataHelp: Zelvo's AI runs tools that change data only after a person approves each use.
mcpServers.missing: The server no longer offers this tool.

urlProblems.url-invalid: Enter a full address without user name, password or #fragment.
urlProblems.address-not-allowed: Zelvo may not connect to this address (this server, internal or reserved networks). The installation's operator can allow internal networks.

errors.address-not-allowed: Zelvo may not connect to this address.
errors.connection-failed: Zelvo could not connect to the server.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
errors.server-error: The server's answer was not valid MCP.
errors.secret-unreadable: The stored credential cannot be read; enter it again.

knowledge.intro: How the knowledge base works for your organisation.
knowledge.publicAccess: Visitors who are not signed in can read external articles
knowledge.publicAccessHelp: Like a public help centre. When off, people sign in to read them; internal articles are always for staff only.
knowledge.numberPrefixHelp: 1–10 capital letters or digits, for example KB in KB-000123. Applies to new articles.
knowledge.prefixInvalid: Use 1–10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter.
knowledge.failed: That did not work. Try again.

notifications.intro: Each notification reaches people in their own language, with their calendar and digits. Switch events off or send them in Zelvo only, and change their wording. Arabic wording should follow the formal correspondence guidelines.
notifications.noMailServer: This installation has no mail server set up, so notifications appear in Zelvo only. Ask the installation's operator to set one up.
notifications.emailFixed: People cannot turn this email off.
notifications.placeholdersHelp: Write a placeholder in double braces, for example {example}. Leave a language empty to use Zelvo's wording in that language. Separate paragraphs of the email with an empty line.
notifications.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
notifications.testEmail: Send a test email to me
notifications.testQueued: A test email is on its way to your address. The delivery log shows the result.
notifications.noEmail: Your account has no email address.

deliveries.intro: Emails of the last 30 days, newest first. Addresses are partly hidden; opening an email shows it in full and is recorded in the audit log.
deliveries.resent: The email will be sent again in a few seconds.

demo.title: Demo
demo.switchUser: Sign in as a demo user
demo.resetWarning: This removes every change made in the demo, in all sample organisations, and restores the sample data. The audit log is kept.
demo.resetFailed: The demo could not be reset. Try again.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.intro: Incidents reported by everyone in your organisation, newest first.
incidents.myIntro: Incidents you reported. Choose one to see how it is going.
incidents.logIntro: Log an incident for someone who called, wrote or came to the desk.
incidents.reportIntro: Tell us what is not working. You can attach screenshots or files once the incident is saved.
incidents.myEmpty: You have not reported any incidents.
incidents.unavailable: Incidents cannot be shown right now. Please try again shortly.
incidents.noAccess: Your role does not include working on incidents.
incidents.notFound: This incident does not exist, or you cannot see it.

filters.label: Filter incidents
filters.atRiskLink: Open incidents at risk of missing their SLA

form.title: Title
form.titleHint: A short summary, for example: The printer on floor 2 does not print.
form.descriptionHint: What were you doing, what did you expect and what happened instead? Include any error message.
form.failed: The incident could not be saved. Please try again.
form.titleRequired: Enter a title of at least 3 characters.
form.groupHint: Leave this to let the assignment rules choose the group.
form.notInGroup: The assignee is not a member of the chosen group.
form.formInvalid: Some answers in the form need your attention.
form.formChanged: The form was changed while you were filling it. It has been loaded again; check your answers and send again.

work.heading: Work on this incident
work.parentHint: For example INC-000123. Leave empty to remove the link.
work.failed: The change could not be saved. Please try again.

errors.transition-not-allowed: The incident cannot move to that state from its current one.
errors.assignee-required: Assign the incident before starting work on it.
errors.ticket-closed: The incident is closed and can no longer change.
errors.parent-has-parent: That incident is itself part of another incident. Link to the main one instead.
errors.incident-has-children: This incident has related incidents of its own, so it cannot be part of another one.
errors.version-mismatch: Someone else changed this incident. The page now shows the latest version; repeat your change.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.ticket-not-open: Resolved and closed incidents cannot be routed again.

work.assigneeInGroup: Only members of the group can be chosen.
work.assigneeAny: Choose a group to see only its members.
work.membersFailed: The group's members could not be loaded. Please try again.
work.routeAgainHint: Applies the assignment rules again to choose the group and, for round-robin, the agent.

reopen.hint: Not fixed? You can reopen the incident until it closes; resolved incidents close automatically after a few days.
reopen.failed: The incident could not be reopened. Please try again.

incidents.closedNote: This incident is closed. If the problem comes back, report a follow-up.

attachments.heading: Attachments
attachments.uploaded: Attached. The file can be opened once it has been checked for malware.

errors.attachment-type-not-allowed: This type of file is not accepted.
errors.attachment-content-mismatch: The file's content does not match its type.
errors.ticket-closed: The incident is closed, so no files can be added or removed.
errors.failed: The file could not be attached. Please try again.

Microsoft365.ClientSecret: Register an app in your Entra ID with the application permissions Mail.ReadWrite and Mail.Send, and limit it to this mailbox with an application access policy.
Microsoft365.OAuthSignIn: Register an app in your Entra ID with the delegated permissions Mail.ReadWrite, Mail.Send and offline_access, add the redirect address below, then sign in as the mailbox.

Gmail.ServiceAccount: Create a service account, allow it domain-wide delegation for the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify, and paste its JSON key below.
Gmail.OAuthSignIn: Create an OAuth client of type web application with the redirect address below, then sign in as the mailbox.
